title: Investigating Societal Biases in a Poetry Composition System
findings: The study's findings for religious groups were aggregated with other demographic categories like race and gender. The general finding was that the data augmentation technique using sentiment style transfer was able to increase the average sentiment of retrieved verses for prompts mentioning demographic groups, making them slightly more positive compared to the baseline model, while maintaining comparable usability.

measurement_description: Sentiment bias in poetry verse suggestions for prompts mentioning religious groups. The study evaluated the language polarity (sentiment) of machine-suggested verses following a user input that mentioned a specific religious group.
